original_markdown:
# add_library

Add a library target to the project. This is the primary command for building audio plugins.

## Normal Libraries

```cmake
add_library(<name> [STATIC | SHARED | MODULE]
            [<options>...] <sources>...)
```

### Library Types

- **STATIC** - Static library (.lib/.a)
- **SHARED** - Shared library (.dll/.so/.dylib)
- **MODULE** - Plugin module - essential for VST3/AU/AAX plugins

## JUCE Plugin Example

```cmake
# VST3/AU/AAX Plugin
juce_add_plugin(MyPlugin
    PLUGIN_NAME "My Plugin"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER "My Company"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE "Mycp"
    PLUGIN_CODE "MPlg"
    FORMATS VST3 AU AAX Standalone
)

# Creates:
# - MyPlugin_VST3 (MODULE library)
# - MyPlugin_AU (MODULE library)
# - MyPlugin_AAX (MODULE library)
# - MyPlugin_Standalone (EXECUTABLE)
```

## Object Libraries

```cmake
add_library(MyPlugin_Object OBJECT
    MyPlugin.cpp
    MyPluginEditor.cpp
)

# Share objects between plugin formats
target_link_libraries(MyPlugin_VST3
    PRIVATE MyPlugin_Object
)
```

## Interface Libraries

For header-only utilities:

```cmake
add_library(MyAudioUtils INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(MyAudioUtils
    INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)
```

## Audio Plugin Best Practices

1. Use MODULE for plugins - VST3/AU plugins must be MODULE libraries
2. Set proper extensions - Configure output extensions per platform
3. Share objects - Use OBJECT libraries to reduce compilation time

implementation_examples.title: JUCE Plugin with Multiple Formats
implementation_examples.code:
juce_add_plugin(MySynth
    PLUGIN_NAME "MySynth"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER "SynthCo"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE "SntC"
    PLUGIN_CODE "MSyn"
    FORMATS VST3 AU Standalone
)

target_link_libraries(MySynth
    PRIVATE
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_processors
        juce::juce_dsp
)
